justification: A hemoglobin value of 30.3 pg (picograms) is physiologically implausible; normal hemoglobin concentration is 12-17 g/dL, and even if this were meant to represent mean corpuscular hemoglobin (MCH), 30.3 pg is at the extreme upper limit of survivability (normal ~27-33 pg), but the code '3' and unit 'pg' combination suggests a measurement that cannot be properly interpreted as a standard clinical hemoglobin value.
